description: Book a client into a service at a start time, the same way the dashboard books. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. A past start is saved as completed with no email. A future start emails the usual confirmation. No money moves through the assistant. Any pay link is only a request the client pays on Appty.

confirm.description: Set true only after the caller has seen a preview and wants it done. Anything else, including the string "true", is a preview and changes nothing.

service_id.description: Service id. One-off shells are refused.

start.description: Session start, ISO 8601. Does not have to be an open public slot.

name: book_session
title: Book a session
